ws_followup_rules.title: CSAT Followup Rules
values: Yes - include CSAT score and feedback
Send apology email to customer with subject containing CSAT

7-day cooldown: Skip all follow-up actions (no note, no priority change, no email) for any customer who has already received a CSAT-related email within the past 7 days. Check sent emails before processing.
Yes - include CSAT score and improvement note
Send testimonial request email to customer

VP Exception: Customers listed in ws_vp_testimonial_overrides get a personal thank-you email from the VP instead of the standard testimonial request. Use the VP email and custom subject from that sheet. Do NOT send the standard testimonial request to these customers.

ws_vip_exclusions.title: VIP Exclusions
values: VIP customers receive personal calls from account managers, not automated followup emails. Do not send any automated CSAT emails.
Email-only exclusion: do not send any automated CSAT emails, but notes and priority updates may still be applied to the ticket.
